scope: credential-free model catalog drift field-count observability
claims: Drift reports expose a deterministic changedFieldCounts object keyed by canonical changed field path.
Each count equals the number of changed models containing that field path.
Unchanged and source-revision-only reports expose an empty changedFieldCounts object.
The field-count report is deeply immutable and every structural drift remains review_required and failClosed.
boundary: Static catalog drift evidence does not prove live provider availability, supported controls, or output quality.
